title: 麻将胡了 2 四爪盘龙与动牌构图候选
intendedUse: 手机大厅麻将胡了 2 卡片背景；中心叠加红色胡了字样并制作循环动效
prompt: Create a premium portrait 9:16 mobile game-card illustration in the established polished dimensional casual-game style. A golden Chinese dragon forms one graceful, continuous circular coil around a clean central title opening, like a living ring. Its head sits at the upper-left part of the ring; its tail remains visibly separate from the head at the lower-left. The coil is broad and readable, not a vertical S pose. Anatomy is important: show exactly four distinct dragon legs ending in four visible paws, each attached naturally to the body and separated enough to count: one forepaw reaching outward near the upper-left shoulder, one forepaw reaching outward near the upper-right shoulder, one hind paw reaching outward near the lower-left coil, and one hind paw reaching outward near the lower-right coil. Keep all four paws inside frame and not covered by the torso, other legs, mane, tail, or mahjong tiles. Toe count is irrelevant. Arrange four to six large traditional ivory mahjong tiles around the outer orbit, each visibly separated and tilted at varied angles to suggest floating motion; show clear red 中, bamboo pips, and circle pips. Keep the exact center of the circular coil as a smooth dark jade-blue open disk, free of dragon, paws, tiles, clouds, highlights, and ornament, sized to hold a large red Chinese title overlay. The title will be typeset later and must not be generated in the artwork. Moonlit jade palace garden and deep cobalt sky beyond the coil, refined gold and jade materials, clear luminous silhouette, premium dimensional casual mobile-game art. Main composition in upper 78 percent; lower 22 percent quiet dark blue for H5 copy. Fixed camera, crisp details, no motion blur.
negativePrompt: three paws, fewer than four paws, hidden limb, paw hidden behind body, overlapping legs, merged limbs, paw cropped by frame, extra fifth leg, detached limb, incorrect anatomy, toes count requirement, dragon stretched vertically, straight S-shaped dragon, open U-shape instead of circle, body crossing itself, twisted or tangled body, duplicate head, head touching tail, tiles covering paws, tiles inside center title disk, any content inside center disk, text, Chinese characters, letters, logos, watermark, UI, blank mahjong tiles, tile backs, unreadable tile faces, photorealism, excessive bloom, clutter, motion blur

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Style and dragon identity only: retain moonlit palace, golden scales, jade details, and polished dimensional illustration.
Use this circular coil composition and floating tile arrangement as the layout reference. Correct the anatomy so four separate paws are visible, and preserve a clean center for a red title overlay.
